div.head: Swer 3
div.ab: Ðæs oðres að, þe mon his orf ætbryideð. On ðone Drihten, næs ic æt ræde ne æt dæde, ne gewita ne gewyrhta, ðær man mid unrihte Ñ orf ætferede.
In illo Deo, non fui in consilio uel in actu, consulens uel agens, ubi per iniustitiam uel facinus abduceretur pecus hoc N.
On ðone Drihten, næs ic æt ræde ne æt dæde, ne gewita ne gewyrhta, ðær man mid unrihte Ñ orf ætferede.

(Eid des anderen [des Beklagten], dem man sein Vieh wegnimmt. B) Bei dem Herrn …, nicht war ich bei Rath oder That, weder Mitwisser noch Mitwirker da, wo rechtswidrig (oder mit Trug Quadr.) dem N. Vieh entwendet worden ist.

(The oath of the other [the defendant], from whom one takes his cattle. B) By the Lord …, I was not at the counsel or the deed, neither accessory nor accomplice, where cattle was wrongfully (or by fraud, Quadr.) taken from N.
[I swear] by the Lord, [that] I [the defendant] was not a planner nor a participant, [nor] a witness nor an accomplice, where someone illegally carried off the N. cattle.
div.note: Here the Quadripartitus read ‘oððe facne’ (compare VI As 1.1 f.). ‘Rath oder That’ and ‘weder … noch’ are alliterating and rhyming pairs.
